headings.text: LGU Tracker is a public directory and map of DPWH contracts: what was built, where, by whom and for how much.
Roads, bridges and flood defences are paid for with public money, yet the record behind a work site is hard to find.
Anyone with a question about a public work, and no time to file a records request.
Ten regions of the Visayas and Mindanao, including Northern Mindanao, home to Iligan City.
Open the record: amount, contractor, progress.
First, search a place, project or contractor.
Then find where it is on the map.
Follow it back to the published source.
SDG 16 · Peace, justice and strong institutions
Search 92,581 contracts by place, contractor, category or status.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Gambarino and General Sans, but the page renders Public Sans, Instrument Serif.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
